trigger_condition: Second import starts while first worker parse is still running
potential_consequence: Newest preview stays blocked behind obsolete parsing

trigger_condition: Workbook has far more rows than the delimited preview cap
guard_snippet: const rows = workbookRows.slice(0, IMPORT_PREVIEW_ROW_LIMIT + 1); normalizedInput = { ...normalizedInput, rowLimit: IMPORT_PREVIEW_ROW_LIMIT, rows };
potential_consequence: Excel previews can stall and lose CSV parity

trigger_condition: Picker or local file read exceeds budget before worker parsing starts
guard_snippet: const startedAt = performance.now(); postWorkerImport(correlationId, sourceKind, { ...payload, startedAt }); // compute final duration from startedAt
potential_consequence: Budget telemetry underreports slow end-to-end imports

trigger_condition: Native picker filters .txt, .tsv, or legacy .xls files
potential_consequence: Supported local imports cannot be selected
